title: Hutch#: Optimal non-adaptive Frobenius norm estimation
summary: The Girard--Hutchinson estimator provides an extremely simple randomized estimate of the Frobenius norm of a matrix $A$ that can only be accessed implicitly via matrix-vector products. In particular, if $Ω$ is a random Gaussian matrix with $r = O(1/\varepsilon^2)$ columns, than $\frac{1}{r}\|AΩ\|_F^2$ provides a $(1\pm \varepsilon)$ multiplicative approximation to $\|A\|_F^2$ with high probability.
